svg.title: Omaparallels
svg.desc: Animated overview of Omaparallels: Omarchy full screen in Parallels Desktop on a notched MacBook. A strip at the top stands for the macOS host behind the VM (its Wi-Fi, volume, Night Shift and the Omaparallels Bridge icon); a link labelled Omaparallels Bridge, 10.211.55.x, joins it to the VM and small labelled packets travel along it. 1. Parallels leaves a black strip beside the notch with Omarchy's bar below it; the bar moves up into the strip beside the notch (Omanotch) and the windows grow to full height. 2. The Mac's Wi-Fi and volume travel host to VM and appear in Omarchy's bar, with a Wi-Fi menu of the Mac's networks. 3. The volume-up key on the Mac keyboard goes to the host, the bridge catches it so macOS shows no popup, the Mac's volume rises, and a volume packet makes Omarchy show its own popup; the brightness keys dim and brighten the whole MacBook screen and Omarchy shows its brightness popup. 4. A trackpad beside the laptop: Omaparallels Gestures sends three-finger, pinch and four-finger touches to a virtual touchpad in the VM; three fingers go to the next workspace, a pinch zooms the web page, four fingers go back; the macOS Spaces swipe is off while the VM is full screen, and Control+Option+Command+Escape hands the trackpad back. 5. Super+Ctrl+N toggles Omarchy's nightlight, a command goes VM to host and the Mac's Night Shift turns the whole screen warm; a monitor card in Omarchy changes the Night Shift strength and turns True Tone on, each sent to the Mac. 6. An external display joins, and the VM's second monitor snaps into the same arrangement as in macOS System Settings.

g.text: the bar beside the notch (with Omanotch)
the Mac's Wi-Fi and sound, in Omarchy's bar
volume and brightness keys drive the Mac, Omarchy shows the popup
trackpad gestures in Omarchy, the macOS Spaces swipe off
Omarchy's nightlight runs the Mac's Night Shift and True Tone
another display, the same arrangement as macOS
⌃⌥⌘ Esc hands the trackpad back to macOS
